faq.q: How does the free trial work?
faq.a: New students get a free trial lesson. Book through the form, and we'll match you with a teacher and a time. There's no commitment to continue.
Tuition is invoiced monthly, based on your lesson length and the number of lessons that month.

faq.q: Can I join partway through the year?
faq.a: Yes. Students who join mid-term pay a prorated amount for the remainder of the term.
